notes: A self-contained editorial field atlas tracing Johannesburg's water supply from the Lesotho Highlands through the Vaal River System, bulk treatment and municipal distribution. Includes a historical timeline, clickable route explorer, treatment-process selector, reservoir buffer calculator, searchable glossary and linked source ledger. Illustrations are inline SVG/CSS; no external runtime dependencies or network requests are required. Reservoir calculations are explicitly illustrative, not live hydraulic forecasts. Rendered and interaction-tested in headless Chromium at desktop, tablet and mobile widths; no console errors, failed requests, broken internal anchors or horizontal overflow observed. Direct file:// and localhost navigation were blocked by the environment's browser policy, so cold-open navigation itself could not be verified.
